name: Pink Script — After Hours
avoid_for: Daytime corporate-professional and traditional B2B contexts where the dark canvas with hot-pink accent reads as too styled or too expressive
weak_cases: Detailed matrices are secondary to the hero; glow and subtle chrome need contrast inspection.
visual_signature: Upright DM Serif display, pink hero glow, warm off-center light and faint internal frame.

provenance.adaptation: Recipe retained and curated for Deck Studio; selector describes source-supported structures, not rendered acceptance.

language_posture: Despite its name this is not a handwriting font system; the upright serif's character still needs script-aware adaptation.

assets.images: No image required; type, shapes and surface treatments can carry the system.
